game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the obsidian gate.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the obsidian gate. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the power_on value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the obsidian gate by solving code steps involving power_on that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the obsidian gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
